types.label: Иконка
types.prompt: One recognizable subject; functional parts allowed. No detached explanatory props. Put symbols on the subject itself. Include a plinth only when explicitly requested.

types.label: Предмет
types.prompt: One hero object or functional set, such as a cup with its saucer; no unrelated props.

types.label: Композиция
types.prompt: A compact group of 2–5 semantic subjects, one dominant hero and meaningful supports.

types.label: Насыщенная сцена
types.prompt: A rich ensemble of 6–12 semantic subjects: dominant hero, medium supports and small accents across several depths.

arrangements.label: Автоматически
arrangements.prompt: Choose a clear arrangement appropriate to the subjects.

arrangements.label: Компактная группа
arrangements.prompt: A compact layered cluster with purposeful overlap.

arrangements.label: Внутри и вокруг
arrangements.prompt: Related contents inside and around a meaningful container; the container counts as a subject.

arrangements.label: Вокруг главного
arrangements.prompt: One central hero with smaller related subjects spaced around it.

arrangements.label: В ряд
arrangements.prompt: A wide horizontal ensemble with varied heights and one dominant hero.

arrangements.label: По диагонали
arrangements.prompt: Arrange subjects along one clear diagonal with purposeful overlap and one dominant hero.

arrangements.label: Пирамидой
arrangements.prompt: Build a stable triangular ensemble: a broad base of supporting subjects and a single dominant apex; no extra pedestal.

arrangements.label: Вертикально
arrangements.prompt: A narrow upright ensemble arranged along one vertical axis; use readable overlap and keep every subject fully visible within the cell.

arrangements.label: Лучами
arrangements.prompt: Arrange elongated subject directions as outward spokes from a shared empty focal point; no central hero surrounded by an orbital ring.

arrangements.label: В глубину
arrangements.prompt: Arrange subjects on a receding depth axis: a clear foreground hero, middle supports and smaller distant accents, with controlled overlap.

arrangements.label: Симметрично
arrangements.prompt: Arrange balanced matching masses on both sides of a vertical centerline; keep one visual focus and do not duplicate subjects beyond the requested content.

cameras.label: Спереди
cameras.prompt: frontal view, camera level and square to the front face; no elevated view exposing top planes except surfaces visible from the object geometry itself

cameras.label: Изометрия
cameras.prompt: isometric view, orthographic projection with parallel edges and equal axis foreshortening

cameras.label: Сверху
cameras.prompt: top-down view, true 90-degree overhead camera pointing straight down, not an oblique elevated view; keep objects in their normal upright orientation instead of laying their front faces toward the camera

cameras.label: Снизу
cameras.prompt: low-angle view from below the subject midpoint, looking gently upward; visible undersides and rising verticals, complete silhouettes

cameras.label: Под углом сверху
cameras.hint: Высокая камера, видны верх и передняя грань
cameras.prompt: high-angle view looking diagonally downward, with both top and front planes visible; not a vertical overhead view

cameras.label: Сбоку
cameras.prompt: true side-profile view, camera level and square to the subject side; preserve recognizable profile, no three-quarter turn

shots.label: Авто
shots.prompt: Choose a readable distance; keep the entire composition inside its cell.

shots.label: Крупно
shots.prompt: Close framing: enlarge the entire composition within its cell, leaving a clear safety margin around every extremity. Fully contained; no cropping or detail-only cut-ins.

shots.label: Средний
shots.prompt: Medium framing: balance subject size with visible breathing room on every side. Keep the entire composition fully contained, without cropping.

shots.label: Общий
shots.prompt: Wide framing: use a smaller complete composition with generous negative space on every side. Keep all subjects together and readable; no added surroundings or cropping.
